tagline: Cut your API spend without cutting capability
description: Every tool here is selected because it produces more output per token or actively compresses context overhead. Ideal for teams on API budgets, long-running agentic sessions, or anyone hitting context limits.

tools.name: token-optimizer
tools.why: Brotli compression + SQLite caching cuts MCP tool-schema overhead from 15K-20K tokens to near-zero

tools.name: sequential-thinking
tools.why: Structured thinking prevents expensive exploratory back-and-forth that wastes tokens on wrong paths

tools.name: fetch
tools.why: Chunked incremental reads mean you only load the portion of a page you actually need

tools.name: sqlite
tools.install_command: claude mcp add sqlite -- uvx mcp-server-sqlite
tools.why: Query only the rows you need instead of loading entire datasets into context

token_savings_note: token-optimizer alone typically recovers 60-80% of MCP definition overhead per session
